# fct_trip_pipeline_transitions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_trip_pipeline_transitions` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table tracking UI stage transitions for trips in the pipeline. Changes may be made via the advisor, or automatically via the system automation rules based on activity within the trip such as Itineraries/Bookable Quotes created, Bookings created, etc. Each row represents a distinct stage change as seen by advisors in the Portal interface. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `trip_pipeline_transition_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each pipeline transition record. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `automation_stage` | The stage that the system's automation logic considers the trip to be in. This can differ from the stage Advisors see in the UI and may update independently based on system rules. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `automation_stage_assigned_at` | When the automation stage was assigned for this transition. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the trip pipeline record was originally created. This timestamp remains constant across all stage transitions for a given trip. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_in_automation_stage` | Number of days the trip spent in this automation stage before transitioning to the next. Calculated as the difference between this stage's updated_at and the following stage's updated_at, or the current timestamp. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_in_stage` | Number of days the trip spent in this stage before transitioning to the next stage. Calculated as the difference between this stage's updated_at and the following stage's updated_at, or the current timestamp. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_since_previous_automation_stage` | Number of days between this automated stage transition and the previous automated stage transition. NULL for the first stage. Used for measuring stage velocity and identifying bottlenecks. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_since_previous_stage` | Number of days between this stage transition and the previous stage transition. NULL for the first stage. Used for measuring stage velocity and identifying bottlenecks. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `following_automation_stage_assigned_at` | The updated_at timestamp from the next automated stage transition. Used to calculate time spent in the current stage. NULL for the most recent (current) automation stage since the trip hasn't transitioned yet. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `following_stage_updated_at` | The updated_at timestamp from the next stage transition. Used to calculate time spent in the current stage. NULL for the most recent (current) stage since the trip hasn't transitioned yet. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_current_stage` | True/False flag indicating whether this row represents the trip's current (most recent) stage. Only one row per trip_pipeline_id will have this as true. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_stage_changed` | True/False flag indicating whether the user-visible stage changed in this transition. True when stage != previous_stage. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_automation_stage_changed` | True/False flag indicating whether the system automation_stage changed in this transition. True when automation_stage != previous_automation_stage. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_trip_archived` | Whether the trip itself was archived. This will persist aross all transitions of the trip pipeline >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `previous_automation_stage` | The previous automation stage before this transition. NULL for the first stage when a trip enters the pipeline. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `previous_automation_stage_assigned_at` | The automation_stage_assigned_at timestamp from the previous transition. NULL for the first stage. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `previous_stage` | The previous UI stage the trip was in before this transition. NULL for the first stage when a trip enters the pipeline. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `previous_stage_updated_at` | The updated_at timestamp from the previous stage transition. Used to calculate time spent in the previous stage. NULL for the first stage. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `secs_in_automation_stage` | Number of seconds the trip spent in this automation_stage, based on the following stage or the current timestamp. Provides granular timing for stage duration analysis. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `secs_in_stage` | Number of seconds the trip spent in this stage, based on the following stage or the current timestamp. Provides granular timing for stage duration analysis. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `secs_since_previous_automation_stage` | Number of seconds between this automated stage transition and the previous automated stage transition. NULL for the first stage. Provides granular timing for stage transitions. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `secs_since_previous_stage` | Number of seconds between this stage transition and the previous stage transition. NULL for the first stage. Provides granular timing for stage transitions. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `stage` | The UI stage that the trip is in, as displayed to advisors in the Portal interface (e.g., 'Inquiry', 'Planning', 'Booking', 'Pre-Trip', 'Traveling', 'Traveled', 'Closed Lost'). This is the stage advisors see and interact with. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `stage_assigned_by` | Indicates whether the stage was assigned by a user or the system (e.g., 'user', 'system'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `transition_sequence` | Sequential count of stage transitions for each trip (1 = first stage, 2 = second stage, etc.). Useful for identifying how far along a trip has progressed through the pipeline. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `transition_type` | Categorizes what type of transition occurred - 'automated_sync' (system changed both stage and automation_stage together), 'manual_stage_only' (user manually changed stage without affecting automation_stage), 'automation_only' (automation_stage changed but user's visible stage stayed the same), 'initial' (first row for the trip), or 'unexpected' (edge case). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_archived_at` | Timestamp when the trip was archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for each Trip record. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_pipeline_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for each trip's pipeline record. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | When this stage transition occurred. This is the critical timestamp for measuring transition timing and stage duration. >> SOURCE - Portal |
